findings.text: blocking: the fragment states the second pin lives in 'the serve extra of [project.optional-dependencies]', but pyproject.toml:186 is inside `dev = [` opened at pyproject.toml:134 under `[dependency-groups]` (header at pyproject.toml:133); the `serve` extra (pyproject.toml:110-115) contains fastapi/uvicorn/uvloop and no imas-standard-names pin at all. A reader auditing the release or the following grammar-sync node is sent to the wrong extra. The same wrong locator is repeated in the head commit's message (526870857, body line 2, 'the one in the serve extra of the optional dependencies'); the fragment must be corrected to `dev` under `[dependency-groups]`.

follow-on: nothing fails if the pin regresses. The node adds no test and its own recorded control (isn-pin-0-10-1-negctl-original-pin.log) shows `uv lock --check` exits 0 with the requirement put back to ==0.10.0 against the unchanged lock, so the gate the done_when names cannot witness this pin in either direction (the node states this honestly). A structural test asserting the pinned requirement in pyproject.toml is what would redden on a revert.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is 'Pin imas-codex to the released ISN 0.10.1'; the diff at 526870857 moves both imas-standard-names requirements in pyproject.toml to ==0.10.1, and in the reviewed worktree at head I re-measured `grep -c 'imas-standard-names==0.10.1' pyproject.toml` = 2 and `grep -c 'imas-standard-names==0.10.0'` = 0, so the pin itself is landed.

item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed run's scope fence (prompt.txt:112-116) grants pyproject.toml, uv.lock, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/isn-pin-0-10-1.html and docs/figures/sn-harmonize-command/isn-pin-0-10-1; the diff touches the first and the third and nothing else, and uv.lock is left unmodified inside scope.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion and no test file, and isn-pin-0-10-1-negctl-original-pin.log shows uv lock --check still exits 0 with the pin put back to ==0.10.0, so nothing reddens if the pin regresses.
justifications.evidence: isn-pin-0-10-1-uvlock-check.log ends EXIT=0 and I re-measured the pin counts 2/0 and the lock digest, but the gate ran in a scratch project rather than the worktree and the node's own control shows it is blind to this pin, so the recorded exit status is corroboration, not proof.

justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition: it is two version specifiers and one evidence fragment, and the fragment extends the existing docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command owner rather than founding a new surface.
